title.narrative: Western Balkans Youth Lab 2

description.narrative: The action aims to support co-creation of relevant policies for youth by increasing the involvement of young women and men in policy making and enhancing co-creation of relevant policies with youth through structured Youth Policy Labs. It will strengthen the capacities of National Youth Councils (NYCs) and Youth Umbrella Organisations (YUOs) in the region. Finally, it will facilitate cultural cooperation among young regional artists by increasing participation of Western Balkans young women and men in regional and international events.
